# Off Switches

An off switch turns off a part of `claudetto` or of Claude Code that you do not need.
Each section below lists the switches of one kind, what they do, and the file that sets them.
Paths start at `src/plugins/claudetto/` unless they say otherwise.

## Four Ways to Turn Off a Part

| Way | Where you set it |
| --- | --- |
| A plugin option (`userConfig`) | When you enable the plugin |
| A key or `env` entry | The [settings snippet](Settings-Snippet) |
| An `enabledPlugins` entry | For a built-in plugin or a `claudetto` add-on |
| A `skillOverrides` entry | Your settings |

The code reads no `CLAUDETTO_` env var as a switch.
`CLAUDETTO_DIR` in `src/kernel/paths.ts` is the name of the `.claudetto` folder.
The facts are for Claude Code `2.1.305`, and the key names match `schemas/claude-code-settings.json`.

## Plugin Options

| Option | Values | Effect | Read in |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `compaction` | `handoff` (default), `built-in` | `built-in` turns off the handoff and keeps the compaction of Claude Code. | `slices/handoff/slice.ts` |
| `decide` | `off`, `jev` (default) | `off` sends no question to Jev. `jev` needs `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`, and then Jev answers each `AskUserQuestion` call that it is sure about. | `slices/decide/slice.ts` |
| `advisor` | `claudetto` (default), `builtin` | `builtin` keeps the advisor of Claude Code and registers no `advise` tool. | `slices/advise/slice.ts` |
| `advisorModel` | An alias or a model ID, default `opus` | Sets the model of the tool `advise`. It is not an off switch. | `slices/advise/slice.ts` |
| `advisorEffort` | An effort level, default `low` | Sets the effort of the tool `advise`. It is not an off switch. | `slices/advise/slice.ts` |
| `backend` of `claudetto-browser` | `agent-browser` (default), `cloakbrowser` | `agent-browser` keeps the built-in `WebSearch`. | `claudetto-browser/slices/search/slice.ts` |

The `prompt` slice also reads the env var `DISABLE_COMPACT`.
When it is on, the `prompt` slice gives the context section the text for no compaction.
With `advisor` set to `claudetto` (the default), the `advise` slice sets `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADVISOR_TOOL=1` at `session.start`, and `claudetto-setup` sets it in the settings.

## Env Entries of the Snippet

Claude Code reads each entry in this table.
The snippet sets no other `env` entry that turns off a part.

| Entry | Effect | Set in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_CONNECT_IDE` set to `false` | No connection to an IDE at start. | `slices/prompt/slice.ts` |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FEEDBACK_SURVEY` set to `1` | No feedback survey. | `slices/prompt/slice.ts` |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE` set to `1` | No change of the terminal title. | `slices/prompt/slice.ts` |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_IDE_SKIP_AUTO_INSTALL` set to `1` | No install of the IDE extension. | `slices/prompt/slice.ts` |
| `DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING` set to `1` | No error report. | `slices/prompt/slice.ts` |
| `DISABLE_EXTRA_USAGE_COMMAND` set to `1` | No `/extra-usage` command. | `slices/prompt/slice.ts` |
| `DISABLE_FEEDBACK_COMMAND` set to `1` | No `/feedback` command. | `slices/prompt/slice.ts` |
| `DISABLE_INSTALL_GITHUB_APP_COMMAND` set to `1` | No `/install-github-app` command. | `slices/prompt/slice.ts` |
| `DISABLE_UPGRADE_COMMAND` set to `1` | No `/upgrade` command. | `slices/prompt/slice.ts` |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CRON` set to `1` | Removes the cron tools and `/loop`. | `slices/setup/slice.ts` |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FAST_MODE` set to `1` | Removes fast mode. | `slices/setup/slice.ts` |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT` set to `1` | Uses the short system prompt. | `slices/setup/slice.ts` |

The entries `CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE`, `CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL`, `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS`, `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH`, and `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` set a value and turn off nothing.
[Settings Snippet Keys](Settings-Snippet-Keys) gives each of them.

## Settings Keys of the Snippet

| Key | Effect | Set in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enableArtifact` set to `false` | No artifacts. | `slices/prompt/slice.ts` |
| `enableWorkflows` set to `false` | No workflows. | `slices/prompt/slice.ts` |
| `promptSuggestionEnabled` set to `false` | No prompt suggestions. | `slices/prompt/slice.ts` |
| `awaySummaryEnabled` set to `false` | No summary after a break. | `slices/prompt/slice.ts` |
| `spinnerTipsEnabled` set to `false` | No spinner tips. | `slices/prompt/slice.ts` |
| `feedbackSurveyRate` set to `0` | No feedback survey. | `slices/prompt/slice.ts` |
| `feedbackDrafts` set to `"off"` | Removes the `SendFeedback` tool. | `slices/prompt/slice.ts` |
| `disableRemoteControl` set to `true` | No remote control. | `slices/prompt/slice.ts` |
| `disableBundledSkills` set to `true` | No bundled skills. | `slices/prompt/slice.ts` |
| `autoMemoryEnabled` set to `false` | No auto memory. | `slices/setup/slice.ts` |
| `includeGitInstructions` set to `false` | No git instructions in the prompt. | `slices/setup/slice.ts` |
| `disableClaudeAiConnectors` set to `true` | No claude.ai connectors. | `slices/setup/slice.ts` |
| `syncClaudeAiSkills` set to `false` | No skills synced from claude.ai. | `slices/setup/slice.ts` |
| `syncClaudeAiPlugins` set to `false` | No plugins synced from claude.ai. | `slices/setup/slice.ts` |

The keys `autoCompactWindow`, `modelSettings`, `worktree`, and `sandbox` set a value and turn off nothing.
The `prompt` slice also hides commands, tools, and attachments with hooks, not with a switch.
See [Prompt](Prompt).

## Denied Tools and Agents

The `permissions.deny` list of `slices/prompt/slice.ts` removes these tools and agents from the model.

| Entry | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `Agent(general-purpose)`, `Agent(claude-code-guide)`, and `Agent(statusline-setup)` | No such subagent. |
| `mcp__computer-use` | Denies the `computer-use` MCP server. It is a guard for the case that you enable the server. |
| `EnterPlanMode` and `ExitPlanMode` | No plan mode tools. |
| `TaskCreate`, `TaskGet`, `TaskList`, `TaskStop`, and `TaskUpdate` | No task tools. |
| `ScheduleWakeup` and `ReportFindings` | No such tool. No `claudetto` code uses either tool. |

The other `permissions.deny` and `permissions.ask` entries are safety rules, not switches.

## Built-In Plugins

The snippet sets these entries of `enabledPlugins` to `false`:

- `cc-plugin-agents-md@builtin`
- `cc-plugin-claude-test@builtin`
- `cc-plugin-diff@builtin`
- `cc-plugin-easel@builtin`
- `cc-plugin-mermaid@builtin`
- `cc-plugin-mods-guide@builtin`
- `cc-plugin-responsive-mode@builtin`
- `cc-plugin-telemetry@builtin`
- `cc-plugin-tips@builtin`
- `cc-plugin-you-should-know@builtin`

The list is in `slices/prompt/slice.ts`.
`cc-plugin-plugin-authoring@builtin` is not in the list, so the snippet leaves it enabled.

## Add-Ons and the Core Plugin

To turn off a `claudetto` add-on, disable it with `/plugin`, or set `enabledPlugins` for `<name>@claudetto` to `false` in user settings.
`claudetto-setup --addons` reads that entry, so it prints no step for a disabled add-on.
Claude Code stops loading the parts of a disabled plugin.

## `skillOverrides`

The snippet sets one entry of `skillOverrides`: `plugin-authoring` set to `name-only`.
The value `name-only` shows the skill by name only.
The effect on a plugin skill is not re-checked on `2.1.305`.
To check the effect, run `/context` in `just sandbox`.

## Never Set

The snippet never sets some keys and env entries, such as `disableAllHooks` and `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL`, because each one forces a behavior on every session.
[Never-Set Settings](Off-Switches-Never-Set) lists them.
